 Order

This miscellaneous appeal is preferred challenging the order under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 aggrieved by the award dated 19.07.2023 in M.A.C.C.No.3163/2020 by Xth Member,
Motor Accidents Tribunal, Jabalpur whereby the appellant has been awarded only Rs.1,06,390/- for the personal injuries.
2.

The facts in brief are that appellant/applicant filed an application under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 for an award of compensation of Rs.7,30,000/- under different heads for personal injuries due to an accident involved with Motor Cycle vehicle No.MP20-NR-5492 owned by respondent No.2 Sunil Kumar and driven by Respondent No.1 Dashrath Singh and insured by respondent No.3/New India Assurance Insurance Company.

The incident occurred on 10.07.2023 at Ashish Kumar Jhariya vs Dasrath Singh on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141291424/
1 8.00 p.m. near Murgawan Tigadda, Katangi, Jabalpur in which appellant/applicant suffered multiple fractures in the mandable and injuries suffered in head, face, leg and other parts of the body due to rash and negligent driving of respondent No.1.
3.

entities.text: Ashish Kumar Jhariya vs Dasrath Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Respondent No.1 contested the claim petition.

4. Tribunal awarded a total sum of Rs.1,06,390/- under heads, bifurcation of this amount is given as below:-
1. Pain and Suffering Rs.6,000/-

2 . Expenses towards treatment and various tests Rs.93,390/-
3.Special Diet and Transport Rs.2,000/-
4. Attendant Rs.4,000/-
5. Loss of Pay Rs.7,000/-
5. The total of those separate heads comes to Rs.1,12,390/-.

The Tribunal has wrongly calculated the awarded amount of Rs.1,12,390/- (One Lakh Twelve Thousand Three Hundred and Ninety only) as Rs.1,06,390/- (One Lakh Six Thousand Three Hundred and Ninety only).
6.
This appeal is preferred claiming enhancement of Rs.1,00,000/- on the ground that Tribunal has not considered the Certificate of permanent disability issued by Doctor.

Tribunal has also not taken into consideration, the multiple fractures including the patella lower and hospitalization of appellant in M.H. Hospital,
Jabalpur from 10.07.2020 to 18.07.2020.
Under the head of loss of income and loss of amenities of life due to disablement have not been properly compensated.

7. Heard.
8.
Learned counsel for respondent No.3 opposed the prayer and supported the award.

9. Perused the record.
10.
The disability is not disputed, therefore, we are considering the medical evidence regarding injuries suffered by the appellant/claimant.

sentences.text: 12. Amount of medical expenses has been fully paid.
Amount under other heads is on lower side.
Looking to the nature of injuries and the loss of amenities due to the injuries, lump sum enhancement of Rs.70,000/- is allowed and this appeal is partly allowed.
